_meta.purpose: Typed question sets for laya_route.py, Laya's zero-token System-1 hop in front of Vanessa.
_meta.mirrors: CLAUDE.md's routing table and model-tiering table, row for row, 2026-09-28.
_meta.rule: Change CLAUDE.md's routing table first, then this file to match. Never the other way.
_meta.note: Tiers only, never model names, per CLAUDE.md and this repo's rule.

brain_route.instructions: Which router row in CLAUDE.md answers this request? Pick the class the question belongs to, not the answer itself.

criteria.about_me: Who Steven is, licences, states, credentials
criteria.decisions: "Why is it this way", a past call, a standing rule
criteria.project_status: Status of a named project (command-deck, isa-portal, ai-team, nonprofit, usc-pjmt-530)
criteria.mortgage_programs: Loan program, guideline, VA mechanics, eligibility
criteria.re_playbooks: Listing, buyer, transaction or showing process
criteria.ai_team: Who on the AI team owns X, seat/model/trust level
criteria.dashboard_ops: A deck panel, DB doc, Mac task or cloud routine
criteria.client: A specific client, by name or clear implication
criteria.references: A source document, playbook PDF, external system
criteria.memory: Something learned in an earlier session
criteria.vector_index: A high-volume corpus: transcripts, disclosure libraries, rule sets
criteria.always_on: What runs when, and whether it actually ran
criteria.remote_access: Reaching Steven, or running something live/remote
criteria.recall_cost: Cost or freshness of a recall itself, not the fact it would return
criteria.live_number: A live number: rate, balance, lead count, health stat

leaves.decisions: context/decisions.md — find the dated entry, read that entry only
leaves.client: wiki/clients/<client>.md — FULL CONTEXT, local vault only, never leaves the Mac
leaves.live_number: the Command Deck snapshot already in context, or the named DB doc

lane.instructions: Which seat on the AI team owns this request, per wiki/ai-team/index.md's routing-by-lane table?

criteria.vanessa: Anything at all, first — Chief of Staff/COO, orchestrator, council chair
criteria.marcus_cfo: Net worth, income, budget, liabilities, close
criteria.derek_cto: Automation health, connectors, stack, what is broken
criteria.nadia_caio: Where AI genuinely helps vs hype, tooling evaluation
criteria.elon_cto_innovator: Feasibility of anything Nadia proposes; the engineering team
criteria.broker_specialists: Lending / real-estate specialist work — Vanessa broker skill, Harrison, Gwen, Marguerite
criteria.apex_trade_advisor: Order flow, market structure, a trade idea (research only)
criteria.report_seat: Execution, reports, benches — the named report seat

tier.instructions: Which model tier (never a model name) should carry this, per CLAUDE.md's model-tiering table?

criteria.orchestrator: Whole-request planning, council chair, final synthesis across lanes — Vanessa only
criteria.executive: A C-suite lane owns this outright: Marcus, Sofia, Derek, Alexandra, Nadia, Victor, Elena or Elon
criteria.worker: A report, bench or execution-only seat does this; no cross-lane judgment needed
criteria.research: This needs external research; Perplexity does the digging, capped at 4 per wave

pii_gate.instructions: Does this request name, describe, or clearly imply one specific client — identity, contact detail, loan/transaction number, income, credit or health data?

criteria.false: No client is named or implied — a program, process, seat, task or aggregate question
criteria.true: A specific client, borrower or their file is named or clearly implied

criteria: not urgent — routine question, no deadline
soon — needed today or this week
blocking — Steven or a client is waiting right now
